title: Winter Performance Review after Mr Cool Universal Heat Pump install: heating cost & tips
summary: Midwest DIY homeowners review a winter on a self-installed inverter heat pump next to their old gas furnace: it heated below zero but cost somewhat more than gas.

assertions.quote: it's more expensive to run electric than gas but not dramatically so
more than capable of heating the house even at below zero temperatures without crazy utility bills
the price of mr cool and its installation was dramatically less than the quotes that we had

verdicts.note: Pre-charged DIY units avoid much of the labour cost, but sizing, permits, warranty terms and electrical work limit the saving.

assertions.quote: our air conditioner condenser died and so they're going to just replace the condenser
making sure that in in a high snow area that those fins don't get blocked
